records.title: Phylogenetic network of the mtDNA haplogroup U in Northern Finland based on sequence analysis of the complete coding region by conformation-sensitive gel electrophoresis.

supporting_statement.paraphrase: Contrasting a complete-coding-region network for 22 Finnish haplogroup-U mtDNAs against HVS-I, the authors conclude that position 16192 is prone to recurrent mutation and that position 16270 has experienced a back mutation; all 22 samples belonged to subcluster U5.
supporting_statement.relevance: An m.16270 ancestral C can therefore occur within a genuine U5 lineage, so the repository guard must withhold a subtype rather than claim exclusion.

records.title: Tracing European founder lineages in the Near Eastern mtDNA pool.

supporting_statement.paraphrase: Over extended Near Eastern (1,234), European (2,804) and north-Caucasus (208) sample databases, the authors state that recurrent mutation in source and derived populations is a major obstacle to lineage founder analysis and that they developed explicit phylogenetic criteria to account for it.
supporting_statement.relevance: Independent, much larger sample base establishing that control-region recurrence is significant enough to require explicit screening before a lineage call.
supporting_statement.independence_caveat: Not fully independent of PMID:10712215: this article cites that one for instability at the neighbouring position 16192.
